Aisha Patel: Quick heads-up — draft analyst briefing set for Wed 4/3 10:00 PT. Need embargo window + quote clearance. Who can own fact-checks and quote signoff?
Ben Liu: I can own quote signoff. Will run final wording by legal. @Diego Rivera can you confirm legal availability? :+1:
Clara Gómez: I’ll own invites and the one‑pager. I’ll also collect preferred briefing times from the analysts if we need to shift for EU/APAC.
Diego Rivera: Legal can do a quick review. ETA end of day Tues if we get the quote now. Any hard embargo time?
Aisha Patel: Target embargo = 2026-04-03 18:00 UTC. Posting plan: embargo → press + analysts, then hosted blog + benchmarks at embargo lift. Draft quote below — please flag edits inline.
Aisha Patel: ```"Redwood Inference reduces end-to-end inference latency by up to 3x and halves per-token costs compared with unmanaged GPU deployments. Our unified runtime keeps tail latency predictable while cutting unit economics."```
Ben Liu: Suggested tweak: replace "halves per-token costs" with "reduces average per-token cost by ~50% in our standard benchmark suite (internal)" — more measurable and defensible.
Clara Gómez: Also suggest replacing "unmanaged GPU deployments" with "single-node unmanaged deployments" — avoids implying all competitor infra.
Diego Rivera: Legal redline: remove "halves" absolute claim unless we append the benchmark context. Recommend: "up to 3x lower latency and ~50% lower per-token cost in our internal 2k-token benchmark versus baseline single-node runs."
Ben Liu: OK — final quote I propose: ```"In our internal 2k-token benchmark, Redwood Inference delivers up to 3x lower latency and ~50% lower per-token cost versus a baseline single-node run, while preserving output quality."```
Aisha Patel: That reads clean. Who's owning fact-check datapoints (latency, cost numbers) for the press one‑pager? Need source CSV and short methodology note.
Clara Gómez: I'll pull the CSV from eng-releases and attach the methodology (batch sizes, model variant, hardware). ETA Wednesday morning.
Diego Rivera: Legal will still want the methodology note for claims. I'll route to security for any sensitive infra details; they can redact internal hostnames.
PressBot: embargo set for 2026-04-03 18:00 UTC. Reminder: do not share assets before embargo lift.
Aisha Patel: Plan for the briefing: Ben primary speaker, Diego secondary (Q&A on security/legal), Clara to screen-share one-pager. If any of you cannot, flag now.
Ben Liu: Confirmed. I'll prepare a 6-slide deck + a 3-min demo clip.
Clara Gómez: I'll send calendar invites with dial-in + Google Meet and include the embargoed assets as private links.
Diego Rivera: Legal will review final quote by EOD Tues and send any redlines.
Aisha Patel: Great — checklist summary: 1) Ben finalize quote (EOD Tue) 2) Clara send invites & one-pager (Wed AM) 3) Diego route to legal & security (Tues EOD) 4) Aisha confirm press list + embargo message. I'll post final embargo message in #marketing 1 hour before lift.
Clara Gómez: Locking calendar now. If conflicts >2, I'll Doodle for alternate slot.
Ben Liu: Will run the quote past product for accuracy before EOD.
Aisha Patel: Thanks team — will follow up with the press list and the embargo copy. :raised_hands:
